maddeler.e:
أنجذب (form VII)
# أَنْجَذِبُ (ʔanjaḏibu) /ʔan.d͡ʒa.ði.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْجَذَبَ (injaḏaba)
# أَنْجَذِبَ (ʔanjaḏiba) /ʔan.d͡ʒa.ði.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْجَذَبَ (injaḏaba)
# أَنْجَذِبْ (ʔanjaḏib) /ʔan.d͡ʒa.ðib/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْجَذَبَ (injaḏaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
